feeds.title: The Conservative Brief
feeds.description: The Conservative Brief was created to promote independent thinking and to share common sense ideas. All The Conservative Brief editorials have these things in common-they promote American family values, freedom, independence, common-sense thinking and self-reliance, taking responsibility as individuals for our own lives in order to help keep our families safe and our country strong.

feeds.title: The Brad Carlson Blog
feeds.description: 'Are the things you are living for worth Christ dying for?' - epitaph of Leonard Ravenhill. The Brad Carlson Blog is managed by a conservative radio host named Brad Carlson. It discusses his beliefs and his radio show.
